item.description:
🔻Specifications:
28 Egg Incubator Dual Power = 220 Volt + 12 Volt Battery Cable Supply
28 Egg Incubator Single power supply = 220V supply     

Voltage: 220 V+12Vbattery cable / 220 V
💥Dual power supply advantage:
When the power supply fails or the power failure circuit is unstable, the power supply can be carried out in time to ensure the normal operation of the machine and avoid the failure of hatching eggs. ( not afraid of power failure, can use emergency batteries to provide power) 


Temperature control range: 10℃-60℃
Working environment: temperature 10-35℃, humidity 40-50PH
Capacity :28 eggs
Material: pp
Packing instructions: carton
Applicable object: chicken, goose, donkey, duck, pigeon etc

💥💥💥Upgraded features：

✅ Ceramic heater:
Good heat uniformity and stability, high functional density
Rapid heating, the surface is safe 
✅Good edge performance
✅ Humidifying sponge:
Sponge humidification design prevents novices from adding water,cause overflow and affect machine incubation.
✅Blister chassis:
When the incubation period is over, the pollution in the machine
The stains can be taken out more squarely by the blister chassis Poop
✅ Touch panel:
Simplified buttons, easy operation, touch buttons
The keys are sensitive, not easy to damage and have a long service life
✅ Power socket:
Hidden built-in power socket to prevent electricity
Safety hazards, and beautiful
✅Comprehensive hatching success rate is higher than 97 per cent.

🔻Product Feature：
✳Roller spacing can be adjusted, suitable for all kinds of eggs
✳[adjustable automatic egg flipping] - high hatching rate, low noise, by turning the egg-shaped motor, the egg can be automatically turned quietly, so that the egg is evenly heated 
✳Simulate the original ecological hen hatching mode, better hatching.
✳LED lights allow you to quickly see how each egg is fertilised and watch the hatching process.
✳Turbine fan, low noise, good moisture-proof performance.
✳suitable for hatching almost all kinds of eggs: chickens, ducks, geese, turkeys, quails, parrots, pigeons and other birds and poultry, and even reptiles. 
✳ Light and durable PP material
✳Built-in temperature control system, very convenient to use
✳ Built-in low noise fan to keep air circulated
✳Well designed air ducts ensure constant uniform temperature
✳One click operation to start hatching process
✳Ceramic heater for quick heating and stability
✳Durable soft touch keys with clear LCD display
✳Translucent cover, more convenient to observe the internal situation.
✳Suitable for hobbies and educational activities, even off the farm

📦Package includes:
1 incubator
1 x Power Cable
1 x User Manual


❗❗Note:
-Water bottles not included
- Dimensions measured by hand may be small in error.
- Due to different lighting effects and monitor Settings, the color of the actual project may not fully reflect the color on the image.
